comparison.objective: Turn and place a brad nailer into its case without pointing it at a coworker or touching the trigger.
comparison.physical_skill: Safety-constrained rigid-tool reorientation, possibly with a bimanual handoff.
comparison.success_condition: Any unsafe pointing or finger-trigger proximity causes zero; credit otherwise depends on final placement, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Its tested ability is hazard-aware reorientation along a safe path, unrelated to coupled threaded adjustment and retention verification.
